description.sr:
Čitanje svojstva od `undefined` ili `null` ne daje `undefined`, nego grešku: ako `user.address` ne postoji, `user.address.city` baca `TypeError`. Zato postoje dva operatora:
- `?.` (opcioni lanac) staje i vraća `undefined` ako je ono levo od njega `undefined` ili `null`, umesto da baci grešku: `user.address?.city`
- `??` vraća desnu vrednost samo ako je leva `undefined` ili `null`. Za razliku od `||`, ne zamenjuje `''` ni `0`: `'' ?? 'x'` je `''`, a `'' || 'x'` je `'x'`.

Napiši funkciju `getCity(user)` koja vraća grad iz `user.address.city`, ili `'Unknown'` ako grada nema.

`user` je objekat. Može da ima svojstvo `address` (objekat), a taj može da ima svojstvo `city` (tekst). Funkcija vraća tekst.

Pravila:
- ako `address` ne postoji ili je `null`, vraća se `'Unknown'`
- ako `city` ne postoji ili je `null`, vraća se `'Unknown'`
- prazan tekst `''` je ispravan grad i vraća se kakav jeste

Primeri:
- `getCity({ address: { city: 'Novi Sad' } })` → `'Novi Sad'`
- `getCity({})` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: null })` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: {} })` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: { city: null } })` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: { city: '' } })` → `''`, jer je prazan tekst prava vrednost, a zamenjuju se samo `null` i `undefined`
description.en:
Reading a property of `undefined` or `null` does not give `undefined`, but an error: if `user.address` does not exist, `user.address.city` throws a `TypeError`. That is why there are two operators:
- `?.` (optional chaining) stops and returns `undefined` if what is to the left of it is `undefined` or `null`, instead of throwing an error: `user.address?.city`
- `??` returns the right-hand value only if the left one is `undefined` or `null`. Unlike `||`, it does not replace `''` or `0`: `'' ?? 'x'` is `''`, while `'' || 'x'` is `'x'`.

Write a function `getCity(user)` that returns the city from `user.address.city`, or `'Unknown'` if there is no city.

`user` is an object. It may have the property `address` (an object), and that may have the property `city` (a text). The function returns a text.

Rules:
- if `address` does not exist or is `null`, `'Unknown'` is returned
- if `city` does not exist or is `null`, `'Unknown'` is returned
- an empty text `''` is a valid city and is returned as it is

Examples:
- `getCity({ address: { city: 'Novi Sad' } })` → `'Novi Sad'`
- `getCity({})` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: null })` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: {} })` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: { city: null } })` → `'Unknown'`
- `getCity({ address: { city: '' } })` → `''`, because an empty text is a real value, and only `null` and `undefined` are replaced

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function getCity` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(user)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `user` je objekat sa podacima o korisniku. Poziv `getCity({ address: { city: 'Novi Sad' } })` daje `user = { address: { city: 'Novi Sad' } }`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 3.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function getCity` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(user)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `user` is an object with the data about a user. The call `getCity({ address: { city: 'Novi Sad' } })` gives `user = { address: { city: 'Novi Sad' } }`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 3 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Cela provera je u jednoj liniji, i čita se sleva nadesno.

- `user.address?.city` čita `user.address`. Ako je to `undefined` ili `null`, `?.` staje i cela vrednost je `undefined`, bez greške. Inače čita `city` iz adrese.
- `?? 'Unknown'` zamenjuje rezultat sa `'Unknown'` samo ako je rezultat `undefined` ili `null`. To pokriva sve slučajeve bez grada: nema adrese, adresa je `null`, nema grada, grad je `null`.
- Prazan tekst `''` nije ni `undefined` ni `null`, pa ostaje `''`. Sa `||` bi bio zamenjen sa `'Unknown'`, što bi bila greška.
- `return` vraća rezultat iz funkcije.

```
user                          user.address?.city   posle ?? 'Unknown'
{ address: { city: 'Nis' } }  'Nis'                'Nis'
{}                            undefined            'Unknown'
{ address: null }             undefined            'Unknown'
{ address: { city: '' } }     ''                   ''
```
text.en:
The whole check is on one line, and it reads left to right.

- `user.address?.city` reads `user.address`. If that is `undefined` or `null`, `?.` stops and the whole value is `undefined`, with no error. Otherwise it reads `city` from the address.
- `?? 'Unknown'` replaces the result with `'Unknown'` only if the result is `undefined` or `null`. That covers all the cases without a city: no address, the address is `null`, no city, the city is `null`.
- An empty text `''` is neither `undefined` nor `null`, so it stays `''`. With `||` it would be replaced with `'Unknown'`, which would be a mistake.
- `return` returns the result from the function.

```
user                          user.address?.city   after ?? 'Unknown'
{ address: { city: 'Nis' } }  'Nis'                'Nis'
{}                            undefined            'Unknown'
{ address: null }             undefined            'Unknown'
{ address: { city: '' } }     ''                   ''
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Najkraće: dva operatora rade posao cele `if` lestvice.
note.en: The shortest: two operators do the job of the whole `if` ladder.

text.sr:
Čitamo adresu u promenljivu.

- `user.address` je ili objekat, ili `undefined` (ako svojstvo ne postoji), ili `null`.
- Ovo čitanje samo po sebi ne baca grešku, jer je `user` objekat. Greška bi nastala tek pri čitanju `address.city` kad je `address` `undefined` ili `null`.
text.en:
We read the address into a variable.

- `user.address` is either an object, or `undefined` (if the property does not exist), or `null`.
- This reading does not throw by itself, because `user` is an object. The error would appear only when reading `address.city` while `address` is `undefined` or `null`.

text.sr:
Prvo proveravamo da li adrese uopšte ima.

- `address === undefined || address === null` je tačno ako je adresa `undefined` ili `null`. `||` znači „ili“: dovoljno je da jedan deo bude tačan.
- Ako adrese nema, odmah vraćamo `'Unknown'` i ne dolazimo do čitanja `address.city`, pa nema greške.
- Ovo je ručna verzija onoga što `?.` radi.
text.en:
First we check whether there is an address at all.

- `address === undefined || address === null` is true if the address is `undefined` or `null`. `||` means “or”: it is enough for one part to be true.
- If there is no address, we return `'Unknown'` at once and never reach reading `address.city`, so there is no error.
- This is the manual version of what `?.` does.

text.sr: Sad je bezbedno čitati grad, jer znamo da je `address` pravi objekat.
text.en: Now it is safe to read the city, because we know `address` is a real object.

text.sr: Ista provera za grad: ako je `undefined` ili `null`, vraćamo `'Unknown'`. Prazan tekst `''` ne prolazi kroz ovaj `if`, jer nije ni `undefined` ni `null`, pa se vraća u sledećoj liniji.
text.en: The same check for the city: if it is `undefined` or `null`, we return `'Unknown'`. An empty text `''` does not pass through this `if`, because it is neither `undefined` nor `null`, so it is returned on the next line.

text.sr: Grad postoji (uključujući `''`), pa ga vraćamo kakav jeste.
text.en: The city exists (including `''`), so we return it as it is.
